affected_system: fixed-route public transit service and passenger connections
alternatives: rank verified high-consequence candidates for transit reliability capital and operations portfolio
select a risk-, equity-, and lifecycle-balanced portfolio for transit reliability capital and operations portfolio
pair passenger-weighted lifecycle project optimization with an explicit stop, review, and escalation rule
assumptions: Trips, stops, vehicle observations, disruptions, and calendars share a versioned service day.
Passenger loads and transfer behavior are measured or represented as bounded assumptions.
All alternatives, capacities, costs, effects, thresholds, and failure scenarios are proposed until bound to evidence.
baseline: fund only already-committed work for transit reliability capital and operations portfolio.

constraints.description: The transit reliability and passenger continuity prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
Every released metric must retain evidence type, source lineage, geography, time, assumptions, and uncertainty.
No analytical output may bypass lawful authority, accountable human review, or an applicable appeal process.

decision_cadence: recompiled at each planning cycle and after material evidence change
decision_owner: transit chief operating officer and service-planning director
decision_question: Which signal, lane, stop, fleet, and operations projects best reduce passenger delay within lifecycle budgets?

independence_key.binding_constraint: The transit reliability and passenger continuity prioritize must respect declared capital, operating, maintenance, and delivery budgets.
independence_key.decision_object: transit reliability capital and operations portfolio
independence_key.evidence_gate: Evidence for transit reliability capital and operations portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

intended_claim: A versioned prioritize design for comparing declared alternatives affecting transit reliability capital and operations portfolio, conditional on its evidence gate.
limitations: This library record has no city binding and therefore reports no local input, output, or recommendation.
Readiness describes explicit source and method gates; it does not certify implementation feasibility.
External domain, legal, community, security, and operational review remains outside this design artifact.

objectives.metric: distributional gap in expected passenger-hours of unreliable service
decision claims with complete evidence lineage

prohibited_claims: Do not report modeled passenger delay reduction as a realized project benefit.
Do not describe a design-only record as a city execution, deployment, adopted policy, or impact result.
Do not relabel proposed, estimated, simulated, optimized, or causal evidence as observed evidence.
Do not infer individual behavior, protected status, harm, or entitlement from aggregate records.

release_gate.failure_release: Release an explicit insufficient-evidence record naming missing sources, failed diagnostics, prohibited claims, and the next validation action.
release_gate.pass_condition: Evidence for transit reliability capital and operations portfolio passes documented checks for cost, benefit, service life, dependencies, deliverability, and maintenance burden.

title: Prioritize transit reliability investments
transportability_risks: Fare policy, headways, fleet, labor rules, topology, and passenger behavior vary by operator.
Reliability metrics may not transfer between schedule-based and frequency-based service.
